name: DictionaryAgent
description: I'm a specialized agent that provide a lean, high-impact fuzzing dictionaries for target projects. I can locate existing resources (e.g., fuzzing dictionary for other projects) from the web and prune them to create a new dictionary for the target project.

skills.name: Dictionary Acquisition
skills.description: Locate existing resources (e.g., fuzzing dictionary for other projects) from the web and prune them
examples: Search the web for existing fuzzing dictionaries that are useful for the target project
Download the existing dictionaries using bash commands
Prune the existing dictionaries to create a new lean, high-impact fuzzing dictionary for the target project
